instruction: Set up VS Code to automatically format all code files in the workspace every 5 minutes using only native settings without any extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have native settings for automatic periodic formatting. While VS Code can format on save, there is no built-in capability to automatically format files on a timer without extensions.
